question:
Five boys B1, B2, B3, B4 and B5 are sitting in a row facing towards north (not necessarily in the same order). Only two boys sit between B1 and B3. B4 sits second to right of B3. Only one boy sits between B2 and B5. B5 is not the neighbour of B4.

Who is sitting in the middle of the row?
